title: Sales Executive – Residential Flat Sales
description:
**1. Flat & Residential Sales**

* **Lead Generation & Pipeline Management:** Convert incoming digital/walk-in leads, manage cold calls, and conduct regular follow-ups with prospects.
* **Site Visits & Presentations:** Guide prospective buyers through project sites, sample flats, floor plans, specifications, amenities, and price structures.
* **Closing Deals:** Address customer queries, negotiate payment schedules/pricing within approved margins, and close unit bookings.
* **Customer Support & Documentation:** Assist customers with booking paperwork, application forms, home loan processing coordination, and agreement signatures.
* **Market Networking:** Build relationships with real estate brokers, channel partners (CPs), and financial advisors to generate channel sales leads.

**2. Joint Venture (JV) & Business Development**

* **Land & JV Sourcing:** Identify prospective landowners, plot owners, and local brokers having clear title land suitable for residential/commercial joint venture development.
* **Landowner Negotiations:** Initiate initial meetings with landowners, explain Joint Venture models (ratio sharing, area sharing, revenue sharing), and present company credentials.
* **Site Evaluation:** Conduct preliminary site inspections, evaluate connectivity, zoning regulations, FSI (Floor Space Index), and local market viability.
* **Proposal & MoUs:** Work closely with the legal and management teams to draft initial JV proposals, Letters of Intent (LOI), and terms for agreement.
* **Relationship Management:** Maintain long-term relationships with land aggregators, local influencers, and property consultants to build a continuous pipeline of JV opportunities.

**3. Reporting & CRM Operations**

* Maintain accurate records of sales activity, lead status, customer feedback, and JV proposals in the CRM system.
* Submit weekly/monthly progress reports on flat bookings, lead conversion ratios, and active JV negotiations.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Real Estate Management, or related field.
* **Experience:** 2 to 5 years of proven sales experience in residential real estate (flat sales) and exposure/knowledge of Joint Venture (JV) property acquisition.
* **Industry Knowledge:** Good understanding of local real estate market trends, legal documentation (MoUs, JDA - Joint Development Agreements), title verification basics, and building/zoning norms.
* **Communication Skills:** Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills in English and the local language.
* **Negotiation & Persuasion:** Exceptional interpersonal and deal-closing capabilities.
* **Tech Savvy:** Familiarity with Real Estate CRM tools, MS Excel, and PowerPoint.

Pay: ₹11,038.38 - ₹50,000.00 per month

**Business Development Manager – Retail**

Industry : Retail

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Business Development Manager with strong experience in the retail industry to drive business growth, improve store visibility, increase customer walk-ins, and strengthen relationships with franchise owners. The candidate will be responsible for optimizing outlet layouts, enhancing product displays, identifying business opportunities, and managing a team to improve retail performance across South India.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Retail Business Development:** Identify new business opportunities and implement strategies to improve retail sales, customer engagement, and outlet performance.
* **Outlet Setup & Visual Merchandising:** Plan and organize retail outlets with attractive product displays, effective space utilization, and appealing layouts to increase customer walk-ins.
* **Franchise Management:** Build and maintain strong relationships with franchise owners and negotiate for effective product placement, display space, and promotional activities.
* **Customer Footfall Enhancement:** Suggest and implement innovative ideas to increase customer footfall, improve store visibility, and enhance the overall shopping experience.
* **Retail Expansion:** Identify opportunities to improve the presence and performance of existing outlets and support the development of new retail locations.
* **Team Management:** Lead, guide, and motivate team members to achieve business targets and maintain retail standards.
* **Market Visits:** Travel extensively across South Indian locations to visit outlets, assess performance, meet franchise partners, and implement improvement plans.
* **Performance Monitoring:** Track outlet performance, customer footfall, sales trends, product visibility, and the effectiveness of promotional initiatives.
* **Competitor Analysis:** Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and customer preferences to recommend appropriate business strategies.
* **Reporting:** Prepare regular reports on outlet visits, business development activities, franchise engagement, and improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* Proven experience in the retail industry, preferably in retail business development, franchise management, or retail operations.
* Experience in arranging and optimizing retail outlets to attract walk-in customers.
* Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills, particularly with franchise owners.
* Knowledge of visual merchandising, product placement, and retail space utilization.
* Demonstrated ability to manage teams and drive business results.
* Willingness to travel extensively across South.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on retail professional who understands customer buying behaviour, knows how to make an outlet attractive to walk-in customers, can influence franchise owners to improve product visibility, and is comfortable travelling across South India to drive business growth.

Weeks become hours. Five tools become one.

• 5x faster research, from question to insight

title: Premier Service Manager- Jalandhar
description:
**Location: Jalandhar**
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Introduction**
The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications And Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge And Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* Exceptional Communication Skills: Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* Strong Interpersonal Skills: Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* Highly Organized: Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* Collaborative Team Player: Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* Proactive and Efficient: Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications**
FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.
  
  
**Additional Notes**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:
**Administration & Accounts Executive**

*Interior Designing Studio*

**Department**

Accounts & Administration

Sr. Accounts

**Employment Type**

Full-time

**Location**

Bandra West

Role Overview

The Administration & Accounts Executive serves as the operational backbone of the interior designing studio. This role is responsible for ensuring the smooth day-to-day functioning of the studio managing administrative processes, maintaining financial records, coordinating with vendors and clients, and supporting project teams with timely documentation and procurement support. The ideal candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a creative, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Studio Administration**

* Manage the day-to-day administrative operations of the studio, ensuring all processes run smoothly and efficiently.
* Maintain and organise physical and digital filing systems for project documents, contracts, client correspondence, and vendor agreements.
* Handle incoming calls, emails, and walk-in queries; redirect and respond professionally on behalf of the studio.
* Coordinate scheduling for client meetings, site visits, and internal team reviews; manage the studio calendar.
* Oversee office supplies, equipment upkeep, and housekeeping ensuring the studio environment is well-presented at all times.
* Liaise with building management, utility providers, and service vendors for smooth office operations.
* Draft and manage internal communications, memos, and policy documentation as required.

**2. Accounts & Finance Management**

* Maintain accurate books of accounts including ledgers, journals, and day books using Tally.
* Prepare and issue client proposals, agreements, invoices, follow up on outstanding payments, and maintain receivables tracker.
* Process vendor invoices, verify against purchase orders, and coordinate timely payments.
* Track project-wise expenses against approved budgets and flag variances to the Studio Director.
* Reconcile bank statements on a weekly/monthly basis and ensure accuracy of cash flow records.
* Assist in preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and profit & loss statements.
* Coordinate with the external chartered accountant for GST filings, TDS returns, and annual tax compliance.
* Maintain petty cash register and ensure all expenses are documented with supporting bills and vouchers.

**3. Vendor & Procurement Management**

* Maintain and update the approved vendor database including contact details, pricing, and performance notes.
* Raise and track purchase orders for materials, furniture, furnishings, and site requirements as directed by design teams.
* Obtain and compare quotations and BOQ from vendors; present comparative statements for approval.
* Ensure all vendor agreements are documented, signed, and filed before work commencement.

**5. HR Administration & Payroll Support**

* Maintain employee records including attendance, leave tracker, and personnel files.
* Process monthly payroll inputs and share with the payroll processing partner; ensure timely disbursement.
* Assist in drafting employment letters, NDAs, and freelancer agreements.

**6. Statutory Compliance & Documentation**

* Ensure timely filing of GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B) and maintain supporting documentation.
* Track TDS deductions on vendor payments and coordinate with CA for quarterly returns.
* Maintain records of all agreements, licences, and regulatory documents, ensuring renewals are tracked.
* Support annual audit preparation by compiling financial records, vouchers, and statements.

Qualifications & Skills

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Business Administration, or a related field
* Diploma or certification in Accounting / Tally / GST is an advantage

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office especially Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP), Word, and Outlook
* Familiarity with GST, TDS, and basic Indian accounting standards

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional organisational and multitasking ability
* High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive business and client information
* Proactive attitude with the ability to work independently and as part of a small studio team
* Adaptability and comfort working in a dynamic, creative environment

Working Conditions

**Working Hours**

Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM – 05:30 PM, Alternate Saturdays working

**Probation Period**

3 months

**Work Mode**

On-site at studio; occasional travel to project sites or vendor locations

**Notice Period**

30 days (post confirmation)

title: Kitchen Helper
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a hardworking, reliable, and detail-oriented **Kitchen Helper** to join our culinary team. In this role, you will play a vital role in supporting chefs and cooks by handling basic food preparation, washing and sanitizing equipment, maintaining cleanliness across kitchen stations, and ensuring smooth kitchen operations during service hours.

**Key Responsibilities1. Food Preparation & Support**

* **Basic Prep Work:** Wash, peel, chop, slice, and dice vegetables, fruits, and meats under the guidance of chefs.
* **Ingredient Handling:** Measure out basic ingredients, assemble prep trays, and assist with portioning food items.
* **Station Setup:** Help set up cooking stations with required utensils, bowls, containers, and ingredients before service starts (*mise en place* support).

**2. Cleaning & Kitchen Hygiene**

* **Dishwashing & Warewashing:** Clean cookware, pans, pots, utensils, cutting boards, and dishware manually or using commercial dishwashers.
* **Station Cleaning:** Regularly sweep, mop, and wipe down kitchen counters, cutting tables, storage shelves, and cooking lines.
* **Trash Management:** Empty trash cans, compost bins, and grease traps regularly; clean waste disposal areas and ensure proper waste segregation.
* **Sanitation Compliance:** Follow all food safety standards, cleanliness guidelines, and sanitation rules (e.g., FSSAI / local health authority norms).

**3. Inventory & Material Handling**

* **Stock Unloading & Storage:** Help unload incoming food deliveries, dry goods, and kitchen supplies.
* **Stock Rotation:** Organize items in dry storage rooms, walk-in chillers, and freezers following **FIFO (First-In, First-Out)** principles.
* **Supply Monitoring:** Keep track of cleaning supplies, detergents, dish soaps, and paper products, informing supervisors when stocks run low.

**Key Requirements & QualificationsMandatory Criteria**

* **Education:** High school diploma, 10th/12th pass, or equivalent work experience (formal culinary training is a plus but not required).
* **Experience:** 0–2 years of experience working in a restaurant, hotel kitchen, cloud kitchen, or catering company. Freshers with a strong work ethic are welcome.

**Technical Skills & Capabilities**

* Basic understanding of knife safety, food hygiene, and kitchen sanitation practices.
* Physical capability to lift heavy food crates, stock bags, or large cookware (up to 15–20 kg).
* Ability to work comfortably in a fast-paced, warm kitchen environment.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong work ethic, punctuality, and reliability.
* Good listening skills and ability to follow verbal instructions accurately.
* Positive attitude and team-player mindset during high-pressure service hours.
* Flexibility to work morning/evening shifts, weekends, and holidays as per kitchen schedules.

description:

Job Description: IT Procurement Manager

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced IT Procurement Manager to oversee IT procurement activities, strategic sourcing, vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and tendering processes. The role involves managing procurement operations, collaborating with internal stakeholders, ensuring cost-effective purchasing, and leading a team to achieve business objectives.

Roles & Responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end IT procurement activities, including sourcing, tendering, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and order tracking.

* Monitor procurement spend, identify savings opportunities, and support budgeting and cost-allocation activities.
* Oversee purchase order management, order fulfilment, invoice-related queries, and resolution of procurement issues.
* Manage vendor onboarding, vendor master data, procurement catalogues, and supplier documentation.
* Identify opportunities to streamline procurement workflows, improve turnaround times, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Prepare procurement reports, analyse supplier performance, and provide updates on savings, spend, and key performance indicators.

People Management Responsibilities

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of procurement professionals to achieve operational and business targets.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor workloads, and ensure timely completion of procurement activities.
* Set individual and team performance goals and track KPIs, productivity, accuracy, and SLA adherence.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and identify training and development needs.
* Support team members in resolving complex procurement issues and managing stakeholder escalations.
* Encourage collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and process improvement within the team.
* Manage resource planning, prioritisation, and coordination across multiple procurement activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Strong experience in IT procurement, strategic sourcing, purchasing, or vendor management.
* Experience managing RFQs, RFPs, tenders, vendor evaluations, and contract negotiations.
* Good understanding of purchase requisition and purchase order workflows.
* Experience with procurement systems such as SAP MM or other ERP platforms.
* Strong commercial awareness, negotiation, and cost-management skills.
* Knowledge of vendor master data, catalogue management, and procurement controls.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated people-management experience, including team leadership, performance monitoring, and coaching.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in MS Excel and procurement reporting.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and drive process improvements.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in
**IT procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor negotiations, tender management, and team leadership**
will be preferred. The ideal candidate should combine strong procurement knowledge with the ability to manage stakeholders, lead a team, and improve procurement efficiency.

Greetings from Infosys BPM Ltd., 
 We are hiring for Walkin Drive for Chargeback & Merchant Disputes (International) Domain for Bangalore. Please walk-in for the interview on 20th October 2026 in Bangalore. 
 Note: Please carry copy of this email to the venue and make sure you register your application before attending the walk-in. 
 Please use below link to apply and register your application. Please mention Candidate ID on top of the Resume *** 
 Senior Process Executive- 1Yr to 2Yrs experience: https://career.infosys.com/jobdesc?jobReferenceCode=PROGEN-EXTERNAL-252154 
 Process Specialist- 2Yr to 4Yrs experience: https://career.infosys.com/jobdesc?jobReferenceCode=PROGEN-EXTERNAL-252983 
 Interview Details: Interview Date: 20th October 2026 Interview Time: 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM IST ONLY 
 Interview Venue: Bangalore :: E-City Phase 2:: Infosys Limited, No. 40/P-41/P, Gate#: 1, Electronic City Phase-2, Industrial Area, Konappana Agrahara, Bangalore- 560100. Landmark : In Between Sunik Industries and Tejas Networks. 
 Please find below Job Description for your reference: Job Location: Bengaluru Qualification: Any Graduate (Full Time) Experience: 1- 4 Years Notice Period: Immediate Joiners to 15 days Shift: Flexible to work with any shift (Including Night Shifts) Work Mode: 5 Days Work from Office Job Level: 2A/ 3A Designation: Senior Process Executive/ Process Specialist 
 Note: Only candidates with international experience are eligible for consideration. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 2A: 
 Role Summary: Own end-to-end merchant dispute handling across Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover, including chargeback, representment, pre-arbitration, and arbitration. Maximize recovery, ensure rule compliance, and deliver a strong merchant experience under network SLAs. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Dispute & Chargeback Lifecycle: Triage disputes (including retrievals/RFIs), validate reason codes, and decide action (accept/represent/pre-arb/arb). Prepare and file Compelling Evidence (CE) for representments within network/processor SLAs. Lead pre-arbitration negotiations; prepare arbitration submissions with accurate documentation and clear arguments. Track outcomes, escalate edge cases, reduce cycle times, and improve win/recovery rates. 
 B. Evidence & Documentation: Collect and package CE: transaction logs, AVS/CVV/3DS data, device/IP signals, delivery proof, customer communications, screenshots, T&Cs/cancellation policies, refund records, support transcripts. Maintain reason-code libraries and SOPs aligned to Visa Claims Resolution (VCR) and Mastercard Dispute Resolution (MDR); ensure documentation is audit-ready. 
 C. Merchant & Stakeholder Communication: Liaise with merchants, Customer Support, Risk, Finance, acquirers/processors, and external partners to gather data and resolve disputes promptly. Educate merchants on prevention (billing descriptors/testing, receipt design, refund policies, shipping/signature confirmation, post-purchase communications). 
 D. Compliance & Controls: Adhere to Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover rules and acquirer/processor guidelines; ensure evidence integrity and privacy compliance. Support monitoring programs (e.g., Visa VDMP/VFMP; Mastercard ECP) by supplying accurate dispute/fraud metrics. 
 E. Reporting & Continuous Improvement: Track KPIs: representment win rate, recovery dollars, TAT/cycle time, pre-arb avoidance, write-off reduction, dispute ratio health. Identify root causes and drive prevention playbooks (descriptor hygiene, friendly-fraud defenses, SCA/3DS optimization, logistics/signature policies). Contribute to automation/templates and quality reviews to enable First-Time-Right submissions. 
 Required Qualifications: 1 to 2 years in merchant disputes & chargebacks across Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover. Practical exposure to VCR/MDR workflows and phases (chargeback representment pre-arb arbitration). Experience drafting reason-code-specific narratives and assembling CE. Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom/Claims Manager, Amex/Discover portals; CRM/ticketing tools. Strong analytical and written skills; ability to interpret payment data/logs to build a defensible case. High ownership, urgency, and resilience under tight deadlines; willingness to work US hours onsite (no hybrid/remote). 
 Preferred Qualifications: Experience with acquirers/PSPs (e.g., Fiserv/First Data, Worldpay/FIS, TSYS, Adyen, Stripe) and tools like Ethoca/Verifi Order Insight. Knowledge of chargeback prevention best practices. Intermediate Excel/Sheets; basic SQL/BI a plus. Exposure to merchant education/training on prevention. Bachelors degree in Business/Finance/Accounting/Commerce. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 3A: 
 Role Summary: Serve as the domain expert for multi-brand dispute managementelevating win rates through evidence strategy, rule interpretation (VCR/MDR/Amex/Discover), and advanced escalationswhile coaching the floor and owning complex/high-value cases. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Complex Case Leadership: Own high-value/complex disputes end-to-end; optimize representment narratives and CE per reason code. Lead pre-arbitration strategies and arbitration submissions with precise arguments and artefacts. 
 B. Rule Interpretation & Governance: Interpret network rule changes; update SOPs/playbooks and roll out training/calibrations. Partner with acquirers/processors on policy clarifications and case-level negotiations. 
 C. Quality & Enablement: Review/approve critical submissions to ensure First-Time-Right quality; reduce rework/defects. Coach Agents; certify new hires for production; drive template/snippet/evidence-checklist improvements.

title: Business Development Executive (Fresher)
description:
Work Timings: 10:00 AM 7:00 PM
 Working Days: 5 Days a Week We Believe Great Work Doesn't Need 6 Days
 Work Mode: Work from Office
 Location:  Marol, Mumbai
 Reports to:  Sales Team Leader

 About IIDE: 

IIDE is India's leading digital business school, offering industry-relevant programs in digital marketing, AI, and business. With a strong focus on experiential learning, we equip students, graduates, and working professionals with the skills required to thrive in today's digital-first world.

Backed by a community of 500,000+ learners and 250+ industry experts, IIDE delivers hands-on training, real-world projects, and robust placement support. With campuses in Mumbai and Delhi, we continue to expand our presence across India and globally.

About the Role:

As the Business Development Executive at Marol, Mumbai, you will play a pivotal role in helping prospective students make informed decisions about their education and career journey at IIDE. You will understand each student's aspirations, recommend programs aligned with their goals, and guide them through the admissions process using a consultative and student-first approach.

This role combines career counseling, relationship management, and consultative sales, with a strong focus on delivering an exceptional counseling experience while contributing to IIDE's enrollment goals. You will manage prospective students from their first interaction through enrollment and collaborate closely with admissions, marketing, and other internal teams to ensure a seamless student journey.
 What You'll Do: 

 Student Counseling & Career Guidance:
 Conduct one-on-one counseling sessions to understand students' interests, career aspirations, and learning requirements.
 Recommend suitable IIDE programs by connecting program outcomes with each student's academic and professional goals.
 Provide clear, accurate, and transparent information about programs, learning outcomes, career opportunities, and the admissions process.
 Build strong relationships with prospective students and parents through empathetic and personalized guidance.

 Admissions & Conversion Management:
 Manage prospective students across the admissions funnel, from initial inquiry through enrollment.
 Convert qualified inquiries into admissions through structured follow-ups, consultative selling, and relationship building.
 Consistently work toward individual and team counseling, conversion, and enrollment targets.
 Maintain timely communication with prospective students and ensure no qualified opportunity is missed.

 Lead & Walk-in Management:
 Manage assigned leads effectively and maintain accurate, up-to-date records within the CRM system.
 Engage with walk-in prospects and guide them through IIDE's programs, offerings, and enrollment process.
 Represent IIDE professionally while communicating the brand's vision, value proposition, and program benefits.
 Ensure every prospective student receives a positive, informative, and personalized counseling experience.

 Additional Duties:
 Collaborate with admissions and marketing teams to support monthly enrollment and conversion goals.
 Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth student onboarding and communication after enrollment.
 Share student feedback and prospect insights that can help improve counseling processes and the overall admissions experience.
 Perform any other reasonable duties as requested by management, aligned with the broad scope of the position.

 Requirements Who You Are: 

 Must-Have:
 0–4 years of experience in academic counseling, admissions, consultative sales, or a related customer-facing role.
 Strong verbal and written communication, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
 Proven ability to convert leads through consultative conversations and relationship building.
 Experience managing leads, follow-ups, and CRM-based sales or admissions processes.
 A student-first mindset with the ability to understand individual career aspirations and provide relevant guidance.
 Strong organizational and multitasking abilities with the discipline to manage multiple prospects simultaneously.
 A proactive, ownership-driven attitude with the motivation to learn, improve, and consistently achieve targets.

 Should Have:
 Experience working in the education, EdTech, training, or professional learning industry.
 Familiarity with sales funnels, lead nurturing, follow-up strategies, and conversion management.
 Ability to collaborate effectively with admissions, marketing, sales, and operations teams.
 Comfort working in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment.

 Nice to Have:
 Experience counseling students for higher education, career-focused programs, or professional courses.
 Certifications or formal training in counseling, sales, customer relationship management, or consultative selling.
 Familiarity with digital marketing, business, or emerging career-focused education programs.

 Benefits Why Join IIDE? 

 Work with one of India's fastest-growing digital education brands.
 Play a direct role in helping students make meaningful career decisions.
 Gain hands-on exposure to admissions, career counseling, relationship management, and consultative sales.
 Work in a collaborative, ambitious, and high-growth environment.
 Build strong expertise in student engagement, sales strategy, and education consulting.
 Learn and grow alongside a dynamic, performance-driven team focused on creating real student outcomes.

 Who You'll Thrive As 

 You're someone who: 

 Genuinely enjoys interacting with people and helping them make informed career decisions.
 Listens before recommending and approaches counseling with empathy and curiosity.
 Can balance a student-first mindset with a strong focus on conversions and business outcomes.
 Is confident communicating with students and parents and can build trust quickly.
 Is motivated by targets and takes ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for direction.
 Thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where priorities can evolve quickly.
 Follows up consistently, stays organized, and pays attention to the details that influence conversions.
 Takes initiative, learns from feedback, and adapts quickly to new challenges and opportunities.

Key Skills: Sales,Tele / Inside Sales,Skill Courses,Admissions,Presales,Branch Sales / In Office Sales,Online Courses,Business Development

Position Title Manager Training (Banking Domain) Location As per business requirement Job Summary The Manager – Training is responsible for leading learning and development initiatives for banking operations, sales, customer service, compliance, and leadership development programs. The role focuses on enhancing employee capability, ensuring regulatory compliance, improving customer experience, and supporting business growth through effective training interventions across the banking network. Key Responsibilities Training Needs Analysis Identify training requirements through performance reviews, skill-gap assessments, business priorities, and regulatory changes. Partner with business leaders, branch managers, and functional heads to understand capability development needs. Develop competency frameworks for retail banking, corporate banking, operations, and customer service teams. Learning Program Design & Development Design and develop training curricula, e-learning modules, facilitator guides, SOP-based learning content, and knowledge assessments. Compliance & Regulatory Training Ensure mandatory training completion related to RBI guidelines, KYC, AML, risk management, information security, and internal banking policies. Support audit readiness by maintaining training compliance records and reports. Performance Improvement Monitor training effectiveness using assessments, certifications, branch performance metrics, mystery audits, and customer satisfaction scores. Recommend developmental interventions to improve employee productivity and sales performance. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with Regional Managers, Cluster Heads, HR Business Partners, and Functional Leaders to drive learning initiatives. With additional presence in the USA, Australia, and UAE, our global reach enables us to deliver high-quality services to international clients with strong technical expertise and local knowledge. Axium Global is established as one of the leading pre-construction planning services companies in the UK and India, serving the building services (MEP), retail, homebuilder, architectural, and construction sectors with high-quality MEP engineering design and BIM solutions. 
 Job Description: The BIM Designer MEP will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and coordinating detailed 3D BIM models and technical documentation for Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, and Fire Fighting (FF) systems in building projects. The role involves working closely with MEP engineers, architects, project managers, and international clients to deliver accurate, coordinated, and clash-free BIM models in accordance with project requirements and relevant standards. Prepare and update BIM models, layouts, shop drawings, construction documentation, and technical drawings. Coordinate MEP services with architectural, structural, and other building disciplines to minimize clashes. Perform clash detection, coordination, and resolution using relevant BIM software. Review project drawings, specifications, and design requirements to ensure accurate modelling. Coordinate with Project Managers, Engineers, Architects, and other stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Update BIM models based on design changes, coordination requirements, and project revisions. Ensure models and documentation comply with applicable project standards, codes, and client requirements. Support the delivery of BIM projects for international clients across multiple disciplines. Qualification & Experience: Diploma / BE / BTech in Electrical, Mechanical, or Civil/MEP-related engineering , or a relevant technical qualification.  Electrical Mechanical / HVAC Plumbing Fire Fighting / Fire Protection Hands-on experience with Revit MEP and relevant BIM software. Good understanding of MEP coordination and BIM workflows. Knowledge of international project standards and experience working on UK/USA/Australia/UAE projects will be an advantage. Good communication and coordination skills.

description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.
* Execute local marketing activities and maintain relationships with local business communities to generate leads.
* Oversee loan renewal mix and repeat customer retention strategies.
* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.
* **Growth:** Total Assets Under Management (AUM) and monthly disbursement volume.
* **Risk & Portfolio:** Non-Performing Assets (NPA) percentage and audit compliance score.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–8 years in banking/NBFC operations, with proven experience in branch management, team hiring, and gold loan processing.
* **Technical Skills:** Interviewing techniques, knowledge of gold appraisal methods, basic accounting, and branch management software.
* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Assistant Manager - Referral & Alternative Sourcing
description:
1. Role Objective

To drive business sourcing, qualified lead generation, site visits, and bookings through Customer Referrals, Loyalty Programs, Employee Referrals, Corporate Associations, Outstation and NRI initiatives, and other alternative sourcing channels. The role is responsible for developing sustainable sourcing programs, achieving assigned business targets, improving conversion efficiency, and ensuring cost-effective execution in alignment with the organization's business plan.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Business Planning & Sourcing Strategy

1. Develop and implement sourcing plans for new project launches and sustenance business through Referral, Loyalty, Employee, Corporate, Outstation, NRI, and Alternative Sourcing channels.

2. Plan and achieve a minimum of 50% of the overall business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels, with the balance 50% attributed to marketing-led sourcing, as per the approved business plan.

3. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head to establish monthly, quarterly, and annual sourcing targets for each channel.

4. Develop long-term sourcing strategies and scalable programs to ensure consistent business contribution across projects.

5. Identify new sourcing opportunities, assess their potential, and recommend initiatives to strengthen lead generation and business conversion.

B. Referral & Loyalty Program Management

1. Develop and execute customer referral and loyalty programs to generate qualified leads, site visits, and bookings.

2. Design structured referral initiatives to encourage existing customers to recommend the organization's projects to prospective buyers.

3. Coordinate with the Brand & Marketing Head to develop referral benefits, customer engagement initiatives, and loyalty program structures.

4. Monitor referral lead quality, customer engagement, conversion rates, and program effectiveness.

5. Identify opportunities to increase repeat business, customer advocacy, and referrals across existing projects.

C. Employee & Corporate Sourcing

1. Develop and implement employee referral programs to generate qualified prospects through the organization's internal network.

2. Establish and strengthen corporate sourcing initiatives through associations with IT companies, manufacturing companies, institutions, and other relevant organizations.

3. Plan and execute corporate engagement activities, employee outreach programs, and targeted property awareness initiatives.

4. Work with internal stakeholders to communicate project offerings and approved employee or corporate benefits.

5. Track lead generation, site visits, bookings, and business contribution from employee and corporate sourcing initiatives.

D. Outstation, NRI & Alternative Sourcing

1. Develop targeted sourcing strategies to generate business from outstation customers, NRIs, and other relevant customer segments.

2. Identify suitable markets, customer groups, and engagement opportunities to expand the organization's sourcing footprint.

3. Coordinate with the Marketing and Sales Teams to execute targeted outreach programs, customer engagement initiatives, and project presentation activities.

4. Develop alternative sourcing initiatives based on market opportunities and business requirements.

5. Monitor channel-wise performance and optimize sourcing strategies based on lead quality, site visits, bookings, and acquisition costs.

E. Site Visit Generation & Conversion Management

1. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Sales Team, and Telemarketing Team to convert sourced leads into qualified site visits and bookings.

2. Maintain a minimum 10% lead-to-walk-in ratio and 15% walk-in-to-booking ratio, as per organizational benchmarks.

3. Achieve an average booking conversion of 15% against the applicable assigned sourcing base, as defined in the approved business plan.

4. Track lead movement, follow-ups, site visit scheduling, actual walk-ins, bookings, and cancellations across all sourcing channels.

5. Identify conversion gaps and implement corrective action plans in coordination with the relevant teams.

6. Take proactive measures to minimize avoidable cancellations through timely follow-ups and customer coordination.

F. Budget & Cost Management

1. Ensure that referral benefits, loyalty incentives, employee and corporate benefits, activation expenses, and other sourcing-related costs remain within approved budgets.

2. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams to plan and monitor sourcing expenditure.

3. Track cost per lead, cost per site visit, cost per booking, and return on investment for each sourcing initiative.

4. Recommend measures to improve sourcing efficiency and maximize business contribution within approved cost parameters.

5. Ensure all benefits, incentives, and commercial commitments follow the organization's approval processes.

G. Payout Management & Operational Coordination

1. Coordinate with Finance and relevant internal teams to ensure accurate processing and timely settlement of approved referral benefits, loyalty rewards, and other eligible sourcing-related payouts.

2. Maintain proper documentation of referrals, lead registrations, eligibility, approvals, booking references, and payout status.

3. Resolve payout-related queries and discrepancies in coordination with the concerned teams.

4. Ensure compliance with approved payout policies, documentation requirements, and internal processes.

H. CRM, MIS & Performance Monitoring

1. Ensure disciplined usage of SFDC (Salesforce) for lead registration, source attribution, lead tracking, and booking updates.

2. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all sourcing activities and maintain reliable channel-wise data.

3. Prepare regular MIS reports covering lead generation, sourcing contribution, site visits, booking conversions, cancellations, expenditure, and program performance.

4. Review performance against monthly and quarterly targets and implement corrective measures wherever required.

5. Use data-driven insights to identify high-performing sourcing initiatives and improve overall business productivity.

I. Governance, Ethics & Compliance

1. Maintain high standards of ethics, integrity, transparency, and professional conduct across all sourcing activities.

2. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, approved benefits, documentation standards, and applicable compliance requirements.

3. Prevent unauthorized commitments, incorrect source attribution, payout irregularities, and conflicts of interest.

4. Maintain effective coordination with Marketing, Sales, Telemarketing, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Sourcing Contribution: Minimum 50% of the approved business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels.

- Lead-to-Walk-in Ratio: Minimum 10%.

- Walk-in-to-Booking Ratio: Minimum 15%.

- Booking Conversion: Average 15% against the defined sourcing base.

- Referral & Loyalty Programs: Achievement of assigned lead, walk-in, and booking targets.

- Employee & Corporate Sourcing: Achievement of approved sourcing targets.

- Outstation & NRI Sourcing: Achievement of assigned business contribution targets.

- Cost Efficiency: Sourcing expenditure maintained within approved budgets.

- Cancellation Management: Reduction in avoidable booking cancellations.

- CRM Compliance: Accurate and timely SFDC usage and source attribution.

- Payout Efficiency: Timely processing of eligible benefits and rewards.

- Reporting & Governance: Timely MIS submission and adherence to organizational policies.

4. Key Working Relationships

- Brand & Marketing Head

- Sales Team

- Telemarketing Team

- Finance Team

- Vendor Management Team

- Strategy and Business Planning Team

- Existing Customers and Referral Networks

- Corporate Organizations and Employee Networks

5. Role Expectations

The Assistant Manager is expected to demonstrate strong business ownership, relationship management, analytical capability, planning, and execution discipline. The role requires proactive identification of sourcing opportunities, close coordination with internal stakeholders, and regular engagement at project sites, including weekends when required.

Success in this role will be measured by sustainable alternative sourcing growth, achievement of assigned business targets, improved lead-to-site-visit and booking conversions, and cost-effective execution within approved budgets.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

description:
About the Job: 
 Institution: Jain School of Future Technology (JSOFT)
 Location: Kochi, Kerala (On-site) Experience Required: 0-3 Years (Experience in Admissions, Counselling, Sales)
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 Company Description: JAIN School of Future Technology (JSOFT) is a mission-driven institution focused on breaking traditional barriers in education and employment in India. The school offers work-integrated programs, enabling students to learn directly from industry experts, tackle real-world challenges, and gain professional experience while earning their degree. Its flagship Work-Integrated BCA Programme combines strong academic foundations with immediate workplace exposure in dynamic professional settings. The school is committed to building skills, enhancing adaptability, and creating opportunities that help learners overcome socio-economic limitations. JAIN School of Future Technology is dedicated to shaping futures and redefining education through practical, career-focused learning. 
 Role Description: The Admission Counsellor plays a vital role in guiding prospective students through their academic journey by providing comprehensive information about JSOFT's programs, admission process, and career opportunities. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi. The Admission Counsellor will be responsible for handling student enquiries through calls, emails, WhatsApp, and walk-ins, understanding students' educational aspirations, and counselling them on suitable programs. The role involves following up with prospective students, nurturing leads, and converting enquiries into successful admissions. The Admission Counsellor will also maintain accurate records in the CRM, coordinate with internal departments to ensure a seamless admission process, and contribute towards achieving monthly admission targets while delivering an exceptional student experience. 
 Qualifications: Candidates should possess excellent communication, interpersonal, and counselling skills to effectively engage with prospective students and parents. Candidates should have strong sales, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities with a passion for helping students make informed career decisions. Candidates should possess experience in Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, Business Development, Customer Relationship Management, Telecalling, or Educational Sales. Experience in the education sector will be an added advantage. Candidates should be proficient in handling inbound and outbound calls, lead follow-ups, and CRM software. Bachelor's degree in any discipline is required. A Master's degree is an added advantage. Freshers with exceptional communication skills and a strong interest in educational counselling are encouraged to apply. Proficiency in English is mandatory. Knowledge of Malayalam and Hindi will be an added advantage. Candidates should possess strong organizational skills, target orientation, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high levels of professionalism. 
 Key Responsibilities: Counsel prospective students and parents regarding academic programs, career opportunities, eligibility criteria, fee structure, and admission procedures. Handle enquiries received through phone calls, emails, website, WhatsApp, and walk-in visits. Conduct regular follow-ups with prospective students to maximize admission conversions. Build and maintain positive relationships with students throughout the admission cycle. Maintain accurate student information and interaction records in the CRM system. Coordinate with academic and administrative teams to ensure a smooth admission and onboarding process. Participate in education fairs, seminars, webinars, career guidance sessions, and promotional activities organized by the institution. Consistently achieve monthly admission targets while ensuring a high standard of student satisfaction. Student Counselling To Apply: Send your updated resume and a short cover letter highlighting your experience in admissions, student counselling, educational sales, or customer relationship management to HR@acced.in with the subject line: "Application: Admission Counsellor JSOFT Kochi"

Senior Analyst - Procurement Research
description:
Do you have a strong understanding of end\-to\-end procurement processes and how emerging technologies are transforming these processes? Are you experienced in primary and secondary research methods? We are seeking an individual to play a pivotal role in our procurement practice, supporting the development of thought leadership and the creation of research content.
 



 At The Hackett Group®, we offer opportunities to learn, connect, and collaborate with professionals worldwide, helping them achieve new performance and competitive advantages. As a procurement research professional, you will partner with Hackett’s procurement advisors, clients, and global stakeholders across industries to understand key trends, issues, and challenges related to establishing world\-class performance. You will be a member of The Hackett Group’s research team, which covers G\&A functions (finance, HR, AI, and procurement), GBS, payroll, and other end\-to\-end process programs. You will work closely with advisors in the Applied Intelligence practice and colleagues across the research organization.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced procurement research professional to play a pivotal role in the development of high‑impact thought leadership, benchmarking insights, and client‑facing research deliverables. This role sits within The Hackett Group’s global research team and works in close partnership with senior procurement advisors and practice leaders.
 



 Success in this role requires exceptional PowerPoint capability, strong analytical skills, and proven research experience. Candidates must be able to operate independently, move quickly, and translate research insights into clear, compelling, executive‑ready deliverables with minimal guidance.
 



**Critical Success Factors for This Role** 




**PowerPoint Mastery – Mandatory** 




 PowerPoint is not a supporting skill in this role; it is
 *core* 
 . The successful candidate must:
 


* Walk in the door with advanced PowerPoint skills, including slide storytelling, visual structuring of complex ideas, charting, tables, and executive‑level layouts
* Work quickly and confidently in creating and refining slides for senior audiences
* Be capable of producing polished, client‑ready decks (e.g., Spotlight reports, benchmark readouts, research summaries) with limited iteration



**Excel \& Analytical Skills – Strongly Preferred** 



* Highly proficient user of Generative AI models (inc. Co\-Pilot) and a proven ability to interrogate and validate the model outputs.
* Solid Excel skills are required for analyzing benchmark data, survey results, and research inputs
* Ability to move from raw data to insights efficiently



**Prior Research Experience** 




 This role requires proven procurement research experience. The candidate must have:
 


* Hands‑on experience with primary and secondary research in a professional setting
* Prior responsibility for shaping research questions, analyzing findings, synthesizing insights, and developing structured research outputs
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, deadline driven environment



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop fresh perspectives on procurement business and technology trends, including emerging areas such as generative AI and agentic AI
* Lead and support the creation of procurement research deliverables, including:
* Benchmark‑driven and Spotlight reports
* Quantitative and qualitative research outputs
* Client\-specific insights and customized deliverables
* Executive presentations and and thought leadership content
* Training, enablement, and knowledge\-sharing materials
* Shape, execute, and synthesize findings from quantitative and qualitative research initiatives
* Translate research outputs into high‑quality PowerPoint deliverables for internal and external use
* Edit, critique, and refine research outputs to meet Hackett quality, storytelling and presentation standards
* Collaborate closely with procurement advisors to ensure research remains relevant, actionable, and client‑ready
* Track procurement and technology trends via market analysis, vendor activity, news, and investment signals
* Ensure turnaround\-time (TAT) targets for all deliverables/requests are consistently met



**Ways of Working / Operating Model** 



* This role works primarily with senior procurement leaders as internal customers who will
* Provide direction on research topics and priorities
* Set expectations for deliverable types, content focus, and timing
* Offer feedback and content insights
* The role holder is expected to:
* Self‑manage workstreams and deliverables
* Take ownership for execution, structure, and quality
* Operate with minimal project management support



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 6 to 9 years of experience in procurement research and advisory role
* Demonstrated experience delivering research‑based insights in a professional environment
* Strong understanding of procure\-to\-pay, source\-to\-contract, supply base planning and strategy, and function management and administration activities within the procurement function
* MBA from a business school of repute with a major specialization in any of the following: Operations / Procurement / Supply Chain Management
* Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills
* Strong proficiency in PowerPoint (advanced) and Excel
* Advanced understand of LLM models (inc. Co\-Pilot)



  





**Additional Skills \& Attributes** 



* Experience with survey design and research tools (e.g., Qualtrics, SPSS, SAS)
* Understanding and exposure to data visualization tools such as Power BI
* Ability to perform rigorous secondary research and synthesize diverse data sources
* High attention to detail, speed, and quality under time pressure
* Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and incorporating feedback quickly
* Self‑driven, intellectually curious, and highly accountable for outcomes
* Flexible and adaptable in responding to evolving research priorities and emerging stakeholder requests while maintaining ownership, quality and delivery discipline

 Role Summary: Own end-to-end merchant dispute handling across Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover, including chargeback, representment, pre-arbitration, and arbitration. Maximize recovery, ensure rule compliance, and deliver a strong merchant experience under network SLAs. 
 Key Responsibilities:

 D. Compliance & Controls: Adhere to Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover rules and acquirer/processor guidelines; ensure evidence integrity and privacy compliance. Support monitoring programs (e.g., Visa VDMP/VFMP; Mastercard ECP) by supplying accurate dispute/fraud metrics.

Identify root causes and drive prevention playbooks (descriptor hygiene, friendly-fraud defenses, SCA/3DS optimization, logistics/signature policies). Contribute to automation/templates and quality reviews to enable First-Time-Right submissions.

Job Description AI/ML Engineer 
 Position: AI/ML Engineer
 Department: Technology / AI & Data Science
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Location: Bhubaneswar, Odisha
 Reporting To: Technical Lead / Project Manager
 Experience: 25 Years
 Qualification: B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or related field 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for a skilled and motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, deploy, and maintain Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions for real-world business applications. The candidate will be responsible for the complete ML lifecycle, including data preparation, model development, evaluation, deployment, API integration, performance monitoring, and optimization. The role may also involve Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), computer vision, NLP, and intelligent automation depending on project requirements. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, train, test, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models. Analyze and preprocess structured and unstructured datasets for model development. Perform data cleaning, feature engineering, feature selection, and exploratory data analysis. Develop predictive models, classification models, recommendation systems, forecasting solutions, and other ML-based applications. Build solutions using Python and ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost , or equivalent technologies. Develop and integrate Generative AI and LLM-based applications , where required. Work with LLM APIs and open-source models for applications such as chatbots, document intelligence, summarization, information extraction, and knowledge assistants. Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and prompt engineering for GenAI applications. Work on NLP and/or Computer Vision solutions based on project requirements. Develop REST APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask for AI/ML model integration. Deploy ML models into production environments and integrate them with web/mobile/backend applications. Optimize models for accuracy, latency, scalability, and computational efficiency. Establish model evaluation metrics and conduct validation, testing, and performance benchmarking. Monitor deployed models for performance degradation, data drift, model drift, and other production issues. Maintain proper model versioning, experiment tracking, documentation, and reproducibility. Collaborate with software developers, data engineers, business analysts, QA teams, and project managers. Convert business requirements into technically feasible AI/ML solutions. Research emerging AI/ML technologies and evaluate their applicability to organizational projects. Follow data privacy, information security, and responsible AI practices. 
 Required Technical Skills 
 Programming: 
Python, SQL Machine Learning: 
Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, XGBoost/LightGBM, feature engineering, supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation and optimization Deep Learning: 
PyTorch and/or TensorFlow/Keras, neural networks, CNNs, Transformers Generative AI / LLM: 
LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, vector databases, LLM APIs and/or open-source models NLP: 
Text preprocessing, classification, information extraction, semantic search, transformers Computer Vision Preferred: 
OpenCV, object detection, image classification, OCR and related vision models API Development: 
FastAPI / Flask / REST API integration Databases: 
MySQL/PostgreSQL and exposure to NoSQL databases MLOps / Deployment: 
Docker, Git, CI/CD fundamentals, model versioning, experiment tracking and production model monitoring Cloud Preferred: 
AWS / Microsoft Azure / Google Cloud Platform 
 Preferred Tools & Technologies 
 Exposure to some of the following will be advantageous: Hugging Face Transformers LangChain / LlamaIndex or similar frameworks FAISS / Pinecone / Weaviate / Chroma or other vector databases MLflow / Weights & Biases Jupyter Notebook Git/GitHub/GitLab Docker Kubernetes Apache Airflow OpenCV ONNX Cloud-based AI/ML services 
 Required Knowledge 
 The candidate should have a strong understanding of: Machine Learning algorithms Statistics and probability Linear algebra fundamentals Data preprocessing and feature engineering Model selection and hyperparameter tuning Classification, regression and clustering Deep Learning architectures Transformers and modern AI architectures Model evaluation metrics Data structures and algorithms ML deployment and inference pipelines API-based model integration Data security and privacy principles 
 Key Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving ability Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues Strong coding and debugging skills Research-oriented approach to emerging AI technologies Ability to understand business problems and translate them into AI solutions Good documentation skills Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration Ability to manage multiple development tasks and project deadlines 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Preference will be given to candidates who have: Developed and deployed at least one production-level AI/ML application. Hands-on experience taking an ML project from data preparation model development deployment monitoring . Experience developing GenAI/LLM applications using RAG or similar architectures. Experience integrating AI models with existing software applications. Experience working with large datasets and production databases. A strong GitHub portfolio or demonstrable AI/ML projects. Experience working on government, enterprise, smart-city, surveillance, analytics, or large-scale technology projects will be an added advantage. 
 Selection Process Candidates may be evaluated through: Resume/Profile Screening Technical Interview Practical AI/ML Assignment or Coding Test Project/Model Demonstration Final Technical/Management Discussion 
 During the technical evaluation, candidates should be prepared to explain one AI/ML project end-to-end , including the business problem, dataset, preprocessing, model selection, evaluation metrics, deployment architecture, challenges faced, and final results.
